summary: Complex Systems 🌀 interdisciplinary nerd with a particle physics ⚛️ background.
Creator and Leader of the **COOLNET** project: **C**ooperation 🤝 in **L**arge-scale **NET**works, using a video game 🎮 to validate cooperation mechanisms experimentally!
Formerly postdoc at Princeton and PhD at École Polytechnique.

announcements.text: **We're looking for a Game Programmer Intern** (Unity / C#, January to June 2027, Dublin) to help on our game Nova Fauna: [see the call](https://www.moddb.com/jobs/game-programmer-intern1). We're also open to hosting interns on **cooperation network modelling and complex systems**: [get in touch](contact.html)!
I am organising a **Workshop on Gamification of Science** in Dublin on **May 31 - June 2, 2027**. Stay tuned for more information on participation, and [contact me](contact.html) if interested!

coolnet_teaser: COOLNET looks for mechanisms that promote cooperation at large scales, and tests them experimentally with a massively multiplayer video game. A 5-year project funded with €1.2 million.
